why_points: The pick: Rush yds higher 0.5 on Underdog. Each pick has to win 56% of the time for a typical entry to make money; the sportsbooks' fair view (fanduel 4.5, moved to this line) is 66%.
Other apps: PrizePicks 3.5. This is the best number for the higher side.
Game log, most recent first: 0, 8, 4, 0, -1, 7, 0, 12. Weighted average 3.3; went higher than 0.5 in 4 of 8 games (48% recency-weighted).

Injury: he left his last game hurt (week 10 vs BUF). That short game stays in his average (players' first game back has historically run below their usual level), but first games back are harder to call, so this prop is held back from ★ and Bet now.
Matchup: LAC has allowed -4% vs the league average to QBs (already shrunk toward average for sample size).
Projection: we expect 3.2 rushing yards on average; in a typical game 1.6 (a few big games pull the average up, so the typical game is what we compare with the line) — 1.1 above the line.

Keeping it honest: on their own, recent games (form) say 59% and the matchup 50%. The sportsbooks are usually close to right, and these methods have only partly beaten them (weights measured on NFL week 2), so we pull them most of the way toward the market: form 65%, matchup 63%.
Bottom line: we give it 63% to win and it needs 56%. The edge is the difference: +6.6 points; that works out to about +12¢ per $1 bet over the long run.
Risks: low line - one play can decide it.
